title: SpecRunnerSpecFrontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a gated spec document (spec/{requirements,design,tasks}.md), serialized by spec_runner.spec.SpecMeta. The spec-runner-vscode extension reads this directly for governance state. See src/spec_runner/spec.py.
$comment: properties describes the canonical fields spec-runner owns (kept in sync with spec_runner.spec.canonical_fields() by tests/test_vscode_contract.py::test_schema_lists_every_canonical_field). Additional keys are deliberately permitted and preserved losslessly under SPEC_META_CONTRACT v2 (extending layers such as steward write their own foreign keys into this file). Stage membership (spec_stage) is validated at runtime against the configured profile, not by this schema.

spec_stage.description: Which gated stage this document is

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 generation timestamp, empty when unset

source_prompt_version.description: Content-hash version of the generation prompt template

validation.description: Cached validation verdict. CACHE ONLY — refreshed by `spec check`/`spec approve`, not by manual edits.

approved_by.description: Approver identity, or null when not approved

approved_at.description: ISO-8601 approval timestamp, or null when not approved

owner_role.description: CODEOWNERS role(s) for this stage, "@role[,@role]", or null when unset
